AC28

**Nemaha Co. Nebraska**

Hypogeous, roughly 4-5cm of soil, in mixed oak/hickory woodland.
- Nearby Trees: Ironwood, Ash, Northern Red Oak, Bitternut Hickory, Bur Oak, American Linden.

Smell: reminiscent of steamed broccoli.

Microscopy: mounted in Melzer's reagent.
